items.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024
items.q: I met him once so I didn’t really get to spend enough time with Phil Woods and I should have.

ctx.x: Is there any Phil Woods in your alto playing that you’re aware of?
People tell me I have Phil Woods in my playing and that was one of those records that I got when I was young. And I think I obsessed a little bit over Billy Joel for a while so —
